decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor has its own dedicated page and fits the firm's announced direction toward environmental sensing modules, so the visible commitment and recent investment argue for keeping it.
This module was just launched as the announced successor to the 2.0 version, so dropping it so soon would contradict the firm's own public replacement decision.

The software proxy is cheap to keep and is publicly presented, but it is a candidate for replacement by a more integrated MQTT solution, so the risk of withdrawal is elevated even though the commitment still favors keeping it.
The CAN interface module serves the industrial connectivity niche central to the modular system, and it is too early to blame any weak results on anything but temporary ramp-up.
The CO2 sensor module is prominently presented and part of the firm's sensing portfolio, so the sunk development cost and public commitment favor keeping it.
The touch panel accessory has its own page and complements the firm's system offering, so any disappointing early sales can still be attributed to the launch phase.
